context: A uni student trades book recommendations with a teen friend
purpose: Teach: 雑談/みなさま/みずから/いささか/今更/余談/題名/はて

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: ねえ、軽い雑談ついでに聞きたいんだけど、最近何かいい本読んだ?
lines.en: Hey, just casual chat, but read any good books lately?
lines.style: Relaxed upperclassman easing into the topic naturally

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: あ、ちょうど一冊あるよ。でも題名がちょっと長くてさ、ちゃんと覚えてるかな…
lines.en: Oh, there's one actually. But the title's kinda long, hope I remember it right.
lines.style: Bright teenage enthusiasm with playful uncertainty

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はて、誰だったかな、前にも似た本すすめてくれた気がする。どんなジャンル?
lines.en: Hmm, who was it again, feels like you rec'd something similar before. What genre?
lines.style: Curious uni student musing to himself before asking

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 青春ものだよ。途中いささか驚いた展開もあって、読み終わったあと結構考えちゃった。
lines.en: It's coming-of-age. Some twists kinda surprised me, made me think a lot after.
lines.style: Thoughtful teen sharing a genuine reading impression

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: へえ、いいね。今更ながら俺、青春ものちゃんと読んだことないかも。
lines.en: Oh nice. Honestly, I don't think I've ever properly read coming-of-age stuff.
lines.style: Casual admission with self-aware college-student humor

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: えっ、意外!余談だけど、主人公がみずからの選択で進路決める場面が一番好き。
lines.en: Wait, really? Side note, my fave scene is the lead choosing his path himself.
lines.style: Surprised teen pivoting into excited fan-talk

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: それ気になるな。じゃあ今度貸してよ、絶対読むから。
lines.en: That sounds interesting. Lend it to me sometime, I'll definitely read it.
lines.style: Warm older-friend tone, committing to the recommendation

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 了解!最後のページに『みなさまへ』って作者のメッセージあるの、それも楽しみにしてて。
lines.en: Got it! There's a 'to everyone' note from the author on the last page, look forward to it.
lines.style: Cheerful teen wrapping up with friendly anticipation
